scope: T-only amendment after full v2 QA. Apply the identical bounded refinement rule to all 11244 banks and all 16 members, including previously passing ones. Preserve original weights exactly; do not restart, exclude trials, or relax QA. Composition reuses the exact frozen v2 prefix; it is not a mixture of v2 and v3 protocols.
algorithm: Each step recomputes strengths, selects first maximum absolute relative-error node and a named-PCG64 uniform other node, then exhaustively selects the best edge swap by summed squared relative strength error. Accept only energy decrease below -1e-18; stop when max relative<=2.5% and RMS<=0.5%, or after 2048 steps. Final gates remain 5% and 1%.
limitations: T-only adaptive method development disclosed; not a uniform constrained graph sampler. Banks shared across training replicates. 512-step pilot retained and failed one bank; 2048-step candidate passed all 44 known failures and 58 prescribed controls. E inputs and classifier outcomes not consulted.
